# Horizon Vantage
> On-site photography, video and fast websites for holiday lets, glamping, B&Bs, experiences and artisan food and drink producers in Co. Wicklow, working across Ireland. One local specialist, from shoot to search.

## Who it's for
- [Stays & experiences](https://horizonvantage.ie/stays-and-experiences/): holiday lets, glamping, B&Bs, guesthouses, activity providers and small venues
- [Food & drink producers](https://horizonvantage.ie/food-and-drink/): artisan producers, farm shops and makers

## Services
- [Photography](https://horizonvantage.ie/photography/): on-site photography, shot at your property, never AI-generated
- [Videography](https://horizonvantage.ie/videography/): short vertical clips and promo film
- [Local SEO](https://horizonvantage.ie/local-seo/): Google Business Profile setup and local search
- [Websites](https://horizonvantage.ie/web-projects/): fast, custom-built sites designed around real photography
